campaign.objective: Choose a reviewed sorting method for 96 generated signed integers. Test exact agreement with a trusted reference on the original input and a distinct challenge input, and reproduce the original result in a fresh process.
campaign.title: Objective-guided sorting study

candidate_selection: first eligible proposal from the selected provider

planning.hypothesis: The insertion sort will produce identical output to the reference on both inputs, while selection and standard sorts may differ due to implementation variance.

proposals.rationale: Measure how insertion shifts behave on bounded generated input.
Compare a simple fixed-pass selection algorithm on the same input.
Evaluate the standard-library sort with the same independent reference.
